title: closure-restriction
description: A closure operator Cl^S over a subscope, obtained by pulling back a host theory's closure operator Cl^T along a type embedding pi : C^S -> C^T, so that Cl^S_p = Cl^T_{pi(p)} for every predicate p in C^S. It refines closure-operator: it is itself a well-formed closure operator, and it witnesses how a sub-theory inherits the host's inference structure (not merely its settled values).

embedding.description: pi : C^S -> C^T, a faithful functor that preserves generator classes, embedding the subscope's predicate category into the host's

host.description: the host theory's closure operator Cl^T over (L, C^T, E) that is being restricted

restriction-law.description: Cl^S_p = Cl^T_{pi(p)} for every p in C^S; literal equality of operators since the fiber algebras coincide (A^S_p = L^{|><| E x E} = A^T_{pi(p)}) -- no translation, projection, or approximation
